Why Sri Lanka?

Sri Lanka combines a highly educated workforce, competitive pricing, and strong English proficiency — making it ideal for global software partnerships.

There are three common ways to hire developers: staff augmentation (add engineers to your existing team), dedicated team (a full squad managed by the vendor), and project-based outsourcing (fixed scope and deliverables).

  • Cost-effective engineering talent compared to US, UK, and Australian markets
  • Strong university pipeline in computer science and engineering
  • Proven track record in fintech, healthcare, logistics, and SaaS
  • Favourable time zone for European and partial US collaboration
